tool_schemas.name: get_service_status
tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18). Release history: v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy; v2.3.1 is unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and was also unhealthy. Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted with a partial failure after us-east (orchestrator error), leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). A second rollback to v2.3.0 completed successfully across all regions. Current state: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. Follow-ups: investigate the v2.3.1 failure root cause, review the orchestrator partial-failure behavior, and decide when a fixed build can be redeployed.

trace.final:
checkout-api is rolled back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and it's healthy again with an error rate of 0.002, down from 0.18.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 is unhealthy, and v2.3.1-rc only ran in staging and was also unhealthy.
- **Partial failure:** The first rollback attempt halted after us-east with an orchestrator error, leaving the service mixed (us-east on v2.3.0, us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1). I checked the state and retried the same rollback, which completed across all regions.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure, the rollback, the partial failure and retry, and follow-ups. The first incident request timed out, so I retried with the same idempotency key. Only one incident was created.

Follow-ups for the team: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, look into the orchestrator's partial-failure behavior, and decide when a fixed build can be deployed. Any future deploy of a version that has never been healthy in production will need change-manager approval.
